# Sakura Player v1.2.1

## 简体中文

v1.2.1 是继 **v1.2.0** 之后的正式版本更新，汇总了 `v1.2.1-beta.1` 至 `v1.2.1-beta.5` 以及近期开发分支的新增功能、体验优化与问题修复。

### 主题、播放页与视觉体验

- **Sakura Liquid 折射玻璃主题**：新增 Sakura Liquid 主题，悬浮播放栏与全屏控制栏可实时折射下方滚动的歌曲列表与歌词；Classic 与 Sakura Liquid 各自保存外观与布局设置。可在 **设置 → 外观设置** 调整折射强度、玻璃透明度、渲染质量（自动 / 平衡 / 低功耗）与主题动效，支持高对比度、减弱动效偏好及滤镜回退
- **全屏播放器布局与动态封面**：新增 AM 风格、全屏歌词与 Sakura Liquid 布局及共享元素封面过渡；支持动态封面（仅 NCM / 仅 AM / AM 优先），并在隐藏或切歌时及时暂停释放视频、中止旧请求及避免回闪
- **三维专辑盒与听歌手记**：专辑详情页新增可开合、旋转的三维专辑盒，盒内展示本机记录的收听次数与首次收听时间
- **列表与界面打磨**：新增专辑分碟展示与滚动吸顶、歌曲列表紧凑样式、Explicit 脏标识别与主题色适配，优化窄窗口与高倍缩放下的控件排布

### AI 听歌陪伴、桌面宠物与弹幕

- **AI 听歌陪伴**：新增 AI 听歌陪伴功能，接入 OpenAI Compatible 与 Anthropic 双协议工具调用，并扩展 MCP 歌词与段落上下文工具，支持按当前播放与节拍状态主动或对话互动
- **桌面宠物与全屏弹幕**：新增桌面宠物浮窗（水平摆动、节拍律动、回复气泡、全局置顶、点击穿透与系统托盘快捷开关）及五种全屏播放器布局下的弹幕展示，并实现设置页、外部关窗与托盘状态的双向同步

### 音频引擎、播放过渡与音质诊断

- **AutoMix 智能混音与交叉过渡**：新增 AutoMix 音频分析与分轨过渡，支持独立组件下载、节拍对齐、原速桥接与过渡时进度条发光效果
- **Windows 本地音频链路与音质诊断**：支持从主播放栏或全屏控制栏音质标签快捷切换输出模式，音质诊断面板可查看源文件、解码 PCM、输出流格式及 WASAPI 独占直通协商状态；修复 WASAPI 独占模式位深锁定 16bit 与解码音质未覆盖列表预估音质的问题
- **播放控制与歌曲高潮**：音量曲线调整为 40 dB 跨度幂函数映射；支持网易云副歌与酷狗高潮多平台标注合并及 CUE 分轨时间线统一，修复全屏播放器高潮标记并新增进度条标记开关

### 歌词对齐、保存与音源解析

- **本地歌词智能对齐与 AI 翻译**：新增本地主歌词逐字对齐，完善翻译与音译对齐、逐行重做音译及辅助歌词完整性校验；AI 歌词翻译支持按排除规则跳过元数据行
- **歌词搜索、预览与保存**：支持手动搜索并切换同平台歌词候选，匹配预览显示播放进度与对唱声部，支持按歌名搜索 AMLL TTML；完整歌词保存支持 TTML（附带 `.sakura.json` 保留逐字译文与跨词音译范围）、音频标签嵌入及 LRC / 增强 LRC / YRC / QRC / LYS 导出，下载兼容格式时生成 `.tr.lrc` 与 `.roma.lrc`
- **TTML 兼容与网易云第三方解析**：兼容空命名空间与单引号属性 TTML 及弯引号归一化；接入 `dm.jfjt.cc` 网易云第三方解析链路并完善音质缓存、下载回退与日志脱敏，修复 QQ 搜索携带登录态 Cookie 与歌词图片导出路径选择

### 悬浮窗、平台修复与底座升级

- **悬浮窗与任务栏歌词**：统一桌面歌词与灵动岛的全局置顶维护、降级无焦点恢复与跨工作区同步；Windows 任务栏歌词改为 owner 嵌入，修复资源管理器重启闪退并适配任务栏可用高度
- **平台与稳定性修复**：修复 macOS 退出卡在关窗阶段及重复注册协议报错、Linux 流媒体凭据迁移与保存、冷启动播放栏收藏状态未加载、专辑音轨号解析与排序异常及嵌套目录误删保护
- **工具链升级**：升级至 Electron 44、Vite 8 / electron-vite 6、Node 24 与 pnpm 12

### 下载与使用

提供 Windows、macOS、Linux 的 x64 与 ARM64 构建，请选择对应系统、架构和安装形式。

使用说明见[播放控制与音效](https://sakura-player.pyabunny.com/playback.html)、[AutoMix 智能混音](https://sakura-player.pyabunny.com/automix.html)、[本地歌词对齐](https://sakura-player.pyabunny.com/lyric-alignment.html)、[AI 功能](https://sakura-player.pyabunny.com/ai.html)与[歌词功能](https://sakura-player.pyabunny.com/lyrics.html)，完整变更见[版本比较](https://github.com/Sakura520222/Sakura-Player/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1)。

## English

v1.2.1 is the stable release following **v1.2.0**, bringing together features, improvements, and fixes from `v1.2.1-beta.1` through `v1.2.1-beta.5` and subsequent development commits.

### Themes, player layouts, and visuals

- **Sakura Liquid glass theme**: Added Sakura Liquid, where the floating playback bar and full-screen controls refract scrolling track lists and lyrics underneath; Classic and Sakura Liquid store appearance and layout settings independently. Adjust refraction intensity, glass opacity, render quality (Auto / Balanced / Low Power), and theme motion in **Settings → Appearance**, with reduced-motion, high-contrast, and filter fallbacks
- **Full-screen layouts and animated covers**: Added AM-style, full-screen lyrics, and Sakura Liquid layouts with shared-element cover transitions; added animated cover support (NCM only / AM only / AM preferred), pausing and releasing video when hidden, cancelling stale requests on track switch, and avoiding cover flashes
- **3D album case and listening notes**: Added an interactive 3D album case in album details that opens and rotates, with listening notes showing local play counts and first-listened dates
- **List and UI polish**: Added album disc sections with sticky headers, compact song-list styling, Explicit badge detection with theme-color support, and layout fixes for narrow windows and high display scaling

### AI companion, desktop pet, and danmaku

- **AI music companion**: Added an AI listening companion with OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic tool calling, alongside expanded MCP lyric and section context tools
- **Desktop pet and full-screen danmaku**: Added a floating desktop pet window (swaying and beat-reactive motion, reply bubbles, always-on-top, click-through, and tray quick toggle) and danmaku overlays across all five full-screen layouts, with two-way sync across settings, window close, and the tray menu

### Audio engine, transitions, and diagnostics

- **AutoMix and crossfade transitions**: Added AutoMix audio analysis and stem-based transitions with downloadable runtime components, beat alignment, original-tempo bridging, and progress-bar glow during transitions
- **Windows local audio pipeline and diagnostics**: Added quick audio output mode switching from the playback bar quality badge and enhanced diagnostics showing source, decoded PCM, output stream, and WASAPI direct-output negotiation status; fixed 16-bit negotiation lock in WASAPI exclusive mode and ensured decoded quality overrides estimated list quality
- **Playback controls and song highlights**: Updated volume mapping to a 40 dB power curve; merged multi-platform NetEase chorus and Kugou highlight annotations, unified CUE track timelines, fixed full-screen highlight markers, and added a progress-bar marker toggle

### Lyric alignment, saving, and source resolution

- **Local alignment and AI translation**: Added local word-level alignment for primary lyrics, improved translation/romanization alignment, per-line romanization regeneration, and auxiliary completeness validation; AI translation now skips metadata lines using exclusion rules
- **Lyric search, preview, and export**: Added manual lyric search and candidate switching with playback progress and duet previews, plus title-based AMLL TTML search; complete lyric saving supports TTML (with `.sakura.json` for word-level translation and cross-word romanization ranges), audio tag embedding, and LRC / Enhanced LRC / YRC / QRC / LYS exports, plus `.tr.lrc` and `.roma.lrc` sidecars during downloads
- **TTML compatibility and third-party NetEase resolution**: Added support for empty-namespace and single-quoted-attribute TTML metadata with curly-quote normalization; integrated the `dm.jfjt.cc` NetEase resolver with quality caching, download fallback, and log redaction, and fixed QQ search login cookies and lyric image save-path prompts

### Floating windows, platform fixes, and toolchain

- **Floating windows and taskbar lyrics**: Unified always-on-top maintenance, focusless recovery, and cross-workspace sync for desktop lyrics and Dynamic Island; updated Windows taskbar lyrics to use owner embedding to prevent crashes on Explorer restarts and adapt to available taskbar height
- **Platform and stability fixes**: Fixed macOS hang during window close on quit and duplicate protocol registration errors, Linux streaming credential migration and persistence, missing cold-start favorite state on the player bar, album track-number parsing and sorting, and nested scan-directory safeguards
- **Toolchain upgrades**: Upgraded to Electron 44, Vite 8 / electron-vite 6, Node 24, and pnpm 12

### Downloads and usage

Builds cover Windows, macOS, and Linux on x64 and ARM64. Choose the package matching your system, architecture, and installation type.

See [Playback & Effects](https://sakura-player.pyabunny.com/en/playback.html), [AutoMix](https://sakura-player.pyabunny.com/en/automix.html), [Local Lyric Alignment](https://sakura-player.pyabunny.com/en/lyric-alignment.html), [AI Features](https://sakura-player.pyabunny.com/en/ai.html), and [Lyrics](https://sakura-player.pyabunny.com/en/lyrics.html), and view the [full comparison](https://github.com/Sakura520222/Sakura-Player/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1).
